run-f1:
Word-for-word English translation:

Hello Daniel, I have sent you two emails about invoice 4471, whose due date was March 3. Please make the payment before Friday. If payment has not been received by then, I will suspend work on the project.

Formality: Informal (tú). The message uses te and realiza? Actually, realiza is grammatically compatible with both, but te he enviado clearly establishes informal address.
run-f2:
Word-for-word English translation:

“Hello Daniel, I have sent you two emails about invoice 4471, which was due on March 3. Please make the payment before Friday. If payment has not been received by then, I will suspend work on the project.”

Formality: Informal (tú). The message uses “te” and “realiza,” rather than the formal “usted” forms.
